name: AI Capability Installation Package
problem: Organizations adding AI capabilities need versioning, installation verification, runtime assignment, rollback and proof the capability actually works.
use_when: add an agent tool to my system
version and verify an AI capability
inputs: Authorized target environment, desired bounded capability, integration constraints and security/authority requirements.
outputs: Versioned capability artifacts, execution contract, install verification receipt, health check and rollback path.
pricing: Current hypothesis $500-$5,000 depending on environment/integration depth; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: Target-environment access, deployment and payment require explicit authorized approval. Discovery grants no deployment authority.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; environment-specific deployment/payment verification required.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
